Chapter 1041: Chapter 5: Chaos (Vote for Monthly Tickets)_2

“It will be very difficult to replicate this kind of physique.”

Lin Yuan concluded.

The Solar Flame Divine Physique was extraordinarily complex, down to its most microscopic components—those flame particles whose surfaces were etched with countless profound and mysterious patterns.

To Lin Yuan, such a structure felt as boundless as an entire universe.

The Solar Flame Divine Physique in its original world was a natural evolution.

It required three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Seeds of the Fierce Sun, cycling together to gradually reform the physical body and vitality until, finally, the Solar Flame Divine Physique emerged.

However, in the Chaos Void, the Seeds of the Fierce Sun were completely ineffective. To replicate a Solar Flame Divine Physique here, one would need to comprehend every microscopic flame particle.

“Take it slow.”

Lin Yuan reined in his thoughts. With his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, unraveling the essence of the Solar Flame Divine Physique was indeed difficult but not impossible.

Lin Yuan’s attempt to comprehend the Solar Flame Divine Physique wasn’t driven by the desire to replicate it in the Chaos Void—rather, he was simply intrigued by the microstructure of its flame particles.

Such comprehension could possibly hint at another grand path, one comparable to the thirteenth-tier legacy of the “Infinite Void.”

Should he achieve such understanding, it would open countless other possibilities. Lin Yuan wouldn’t need to confine himself to the Solar Flame Divine Physique.

He could easily create various physiques equivalent to the Solar Flame Divine Physique, achieving unimaginable heights on the path of physical vitality.

…

Qingfen City.

A purple-haired woman gathered with other powerful figures of the Purple Dream Domain.

“We finally managed to infiltrate.”

A gaunt man spoke with a solemn expression.

At present, they were inside Qingfen City. If they were discovered, it would mean certain death.

Lord Qingfen could obliterate them with a single thought.

“We used secret treasures to completely conceal our auras. As long as Lord Qingfen doesn’t deliberately inspect us, he won’t notice.”

The purple-haired woman’s tone was calm.

Qingfen City, as the domain city and the core of the Qingfen Domain, saw countless powerful beings entering and leaving regularly. How could Lord Qingfen possibly investigate every single entity entering the city?

“If Qingfen City didn’t have a formation specifically designed to detect the thickness and weight of life, it wouldn’t have been so difficult for just a handful of us to infiltrate.”

The purple-haired woman shook her head slightly.

At this moment, there were only twelve of them who had infiltrated Qingfen City from the Purple Dream Domain. Any more would risk alerting the life-detection formation and drawing Lord Qingfen’s attention.

Life has both thickness and weight. Auras can be concealed, but the thickness and weight of life cannot be hidden.

Occasionally, Qingfen City might see the arrival of a dozen Sovereign-level beings. That wouldn’t be unusual.

But if the numbers increased beyond that, it would become suspicious.

If fifty or a hundred Sovereign-level beings were dispatched and the thickness and weight of life in Qingfen City surpassed the vigilance threshold, Lord Qingfen—even if unaware of abnormalities—would conduct a thorough investigation of the city.

If such an investigation began, Qingfen City would enter full defensive mode. At that point, with Lord Qingfen on guard, it would be highly uncertain whether Marquis Purple Dream could accomplish their objective.

“This mission is crucial. Using the Myriad Formation Crystal to replicate all the arrays in Qingfen City can only succeed; it must not fail.”

The purple-haired woman spoke with solemnity. If such a plan failed, any future attempt to attack the Qingfen Domain would come at an unimaginably high cost.

And even then, it might not succeed.

“Understood.”

The others nodded. They were fully aware of the gravity of their task.

For this mission, they had even brought the Myriad Formation Crystal—a priceless treasure—to replicate the formation arrays.

The Myriad Formation Crystal was forged through the painstaking efforts of a Formation Master from the Ancient Nation, and its value was immeasurable.

If this plan hadn’t involved a strategy of an Ancient Nation-level magnitude, the Myriad Formation Crystal would not have been used.

“Senior sister, what’s our next move?”

An elderly, hunched woman turned to the purple-haired woman, asking softly.

“Wait.”

The purple-haired woman replied.

“Wait?”

The group exchanged glances.

“Wait for our master to make a move. He will occupy Lord Qingfen, and then we will proceed with the plan.”

The purple-haired woman’s tone remained composed. If Lord Qingfen retained any spare capacity to act, they wouldn’t dare to reveal even a hint of their aura, let alone use the Myriad Formation Crystal to replicate the arrays.

“Understood.”

The group nodded.

Before infiltrating Qingfen City, they had no knowledge of how their plan would unfold. It was only after entering the city that the purple-haired woman informed them of the subsequent steps.

“Let’s hope everything goes smoothly.”

The purple-haired woman thought silently to herself.

If they successfully replicated Qingfen City’s arrays, she would earn immense merit. With the Ancient Nation’s rewards, she might even fully step into the level of a Great Lord.

The purple-haired woman was at the peak of Sovereign-level, with one foot already in the realm of Great Lords.

She was acutely aware of the vast gap between a Great Lord and those below that rank.

In fact, all ten-plus powerful figures from the Purple Dream Domain who had infiltrated were mostly at half-step Great Lord strength.

Given the limitation in numbers, the infiltrators were naturally the strongest of those at the Sovereign level.

…

“Hmm?”

Lord Qingfen, who had been meditating in seclusion, abruptly opened his eyes.

Not far away, a figure silently coalesced—the silhouette of a woman clad in a purple skirt.

“Purple Dream.” Lord Qingfen gazed at the purple-skirted woman and smiled. “Why send only an avatar here?”

If the purple-skirted woman had descended in her true form, Lord Qingfen wouldn’t waste a single word. He would have immediately activated Qingfen City’s grand array to suppress her.

Capturing a feudal lord from an enemy Ancient Nation alive would be a monumental achievement.

Even if it wasn’t possible to capture her alive, killing or severely injuring her would still greatly benefit Lord Qingfen.

But unfortunately—

Lord Qingfen was acutely aware that the Purple Dream Marquis standing before him was merely an avatar.

“To me, there’s little difference between an avatar and my true form.” Marquis Purple Dream’s tone was gentle. The path she walked was rooted in Soul Illusion; she was not proficient in matters of the physical body.
